summary: The site is live at https://jollyrogercharter.org and is rebuilt from the public repository on every merge to main. JRCv1 is a draft conformance standard, not a licence. Nothing has been independently reproduced, the founding transcript is not published, and the timestamp proof is not yet confirmed.

items.title: Public repository
items.evidence: Public, CC0-1.0 detected by GitHub.

items.title: Org 2FA and branch protection
items.evidence: Org requires 2FA. Ruleset protect-main requires a pull request and the build-and-test check, and blocks force-push and deletion.

items.title: Second organization owner
items.evidence: One owner invitation outstanding; one active admin.
items.next: Invitee accepts; then raise required approvals on main to 1.

items.title: Continuous integration
items.evidence: build-and-test passes on main and pull requests.

items.title: Domain jollyrogercharter.org
items.evidence: Cloudflare Registrar; registered 2026-10-18; $8.50 first year, renews $11.20/yr, auto-renew on.

items.title: Hosting and HTTPS
items.evidence: Cloudflare Pages free plan, auto-deploys from main. HTTP redirects to HTTPS with a 301. Served provenance manifest matches the repository byte for byte.

items.title: www.jollyrogercharter.org
items.evidence: No DNS record, so the www address does not resolve.
items.next: Add www as a second custom domain in Cloudflare Pages, or a redirect rule to the apex.

items.title: Second, independent host
items.evidence: DEPLOYMENT.md documents alternatives; none deployed.
items.next: Anyone can deploy a mirror from a fork; the project has not done so yet.

items.title: CC0 1.0 dedication
items.evidence: LICENSE holds the official CC0 1.0 text; NOTICE.md lists exclusions. Decided by the human initiator without counsel.

items.title: Legal review of the dedication
items.evidence: No counsel has reviewed it.
items.next: Find a volunteer or paid open-source licensing reviewer.

items.title: SHA-256 digests of the founding package
items.evidence: 36 files plus the received ZIP; a test re-verifies them against Git.

items.title: OpenTimestamps proof of the digest list
items.evidence: Submitted 2026-10-18T04:36Z. At 04:51Z a calendar reported inclusion in a Bitcoin transaction awaiting 6 confirmations. ots verify has not succeeded yet.
items.next: Run ots upgrade, then ots verify; record the block time only if verify succeeds.

items.title: Founding conversation transcript
items.evidence: No ChatGPT export has been supplied. The site shows a curated archive labelled as a summary.
items.next: Human exports the conversation; the agent drafts a redacted edition for review.

items.title: GitHub Discussions
items.evidence: Enabled with GitHub's default categories; no posts yet.

items.title: Charter discussion categories and seed RFCs
items.evidence: Categories proposed in launch/RFC-SEEDS.md are not created; GitHub only allows that in the web UI. Seed RFCs are drafted, not posted.
items.next: Human creates the categories and approves the RFC text for posting.

items.title: Jolly Roger Challenge
items.evidence: Published with issue template.

items.title: Independent reproduction of this project

items.next: An unrelated person runs launch/FOUNDER-ABSENCE-TEST.md and files a report.
